newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Q1 trade deficit narrows 8.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Q1 trade deficit narrows 8.7 pct.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit narrowed 8.7 percent to 23.61 billion schillings in the first quarter of 1997, state statistics office OeSTAT said on Friday.
In a statement OeSTAT said imports rose five percent to 184.2 billion schillings while exports climbed 7.3 percent to 160.6 billion schillings.

Austria's trade deficit with European Union states narrowed slightly to 24.3 billion compared to 25.4 billion in the first quarter of 1996, while trade with non-EU countries registered a surplus after a deficit last year.
Imports from European Union partners rose to 127.2 billion schillings, compared to 124.9 billion in the same period last year, while exports rose 3.5 percent to 102.9 billion schillings.
Imports from non-EU countries were up 12.7 percent to 56.98 billion schillings while exports climbed 15.1 percent to 57.66 billion.
The OeSTAT attributed the growth of trade with non-EU countries to the strength of the dollar and favourable economic developments in some of the countries. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
